name: audioTest
summary: Toy browser audio checkpoint player with keyboard controls

nodes.name: src/public/index.html
nodes.summary: Two-phase UI with persisted-audio card library, upload trigger, and player with checkpoint/subSeg overlays, load-state indicator, custom playhead, child-source substring annotations rendered with mirror-measured compact numbered bubbles, elbow badges, whitespace-trimmed selection spans with tighter horizontal fit, and a bottom-right decorative multiline comment bubble attached to each input card that grows downward while spacing out following cards through a dedicated flow spacer

features.summary: Render persisted-audio card list with queued auto-save on upload/checkpoint/subSeg updates, keep uploads in phase one until persistence completes, disable card selection during save, show a player loading bar while audEp restore completes, bubble child-source substrings with mirror-measured compact ordered badges in the parent input card list, add a bottom-right attached multiline comment bubble textarea to each card with the same no-fill audSeg progress-bar color, a 5px right inset, a 7px top overlap, and downward vertical growth reserved by a sibling flow spacer so lower cards are pushed without the card container itself expanding, trim surrounding whitespace from each selection span at render time, tighten the horizontal fit around each bubble, and mirror the same child order on nested connector elbows with 10px child indentation

nodes.name: src/frontend/app.js
nodes.summary: Refactored audio controller with centralized state/UI updates, session save/restore via backend API, revision conflict handling, audSeg target-lock playback mode, and auth-scoped requests

features.summary: Keyboard controls and looping are preserved while Enter can lock a selected audSeg into target mode with a second loop progress bar, Shift hold plus Shift+Space creates subSegs that persist with checkpoints and render on both audEp and target bars, draggable checkpoint markers/tags support micro-adjust with magnifier and 500ms live preview, Ctrl+arrows cycle target-local subSegs, Ctrl+Up/Down now cycles delete targets for checkpoints or target subSeg tags with an x badge and Enter opens confirm-delete (Cancel default), startup restore waits for full audio metadata load via GET /api/session, save payloads include baseRevision for conflict-safe writes, and upload now rejects non-blob pseudo files to prevent corrupted audio blobs

nodes.name: URL.createObjectURL
nodes.summary: In-memory object URL used for selected local audio file

nodes.name: src/backend/server.js
nodes.summary: Node HTTP server with persisted-audio list/detail APIs, revision-aware conflict responses, hardened static path resolution, and owner-scoped auth for session/audio operations

features.summary: GET /api/sessions and GET/POST/DELETE /api/session plus GET/POST /api/audio require authenticated user context; session writes enforce baseRevision conflict checks

nodes.name: data/session-latest.json
nodes.summary: Project-local persisted session record including audio payload and playback state

edges.note: Space toggles playback and arrows perform relative seeking

Shift+Space creates checkpoints in normal mode; in target mode Shift hold arms tss and Shift+Space commits subSegs while Ctrl+arrows cycle only target subSegs; checkpoint drag updates audSeg/subSeg membership immediately
